description: This line plot illustrates the QA performance, confidence, and alignment of ChatGPT as a function of question popularity, ranging from 5 to 25 on the x-axis, labeled "Question Popularity". The y-axis, labeled "Values", spans from 0.55 to 1.00 in linear scale, representing normalized metrics. Three distinct lines are plotted: the blue line with circle markers represents "Accuracy", starting at approximately 0.60 at question popularity 5, rising to a peak of 0.81 at popularity 11, dipping to 0.71 at popularity 14, and then rising again to 0.88 at popularity 25. The green line with triangle markers represents "Confidence", beginning near 0.93 at popularity 5, showing slight fluctuations, and ending at approximately 0.98 at popularity 25. The red line with square markers represents "Alignment", starting at 0.69 at popularity 5, increasing to 0.85 at popularity 10, dipping to 0.78 at popularity 14, and then rising to 0.90 at popularity 25.
